nodes.label: Planner (agent)
nodes.rationale: Read-only. Turns one roadmap item into an exact, buildable spec citing committed HEAD lines; returns FENCED for fenced items so risky changes never get specced.

nodes.label: Builder (agent)
nodes.rationale: Implements exactly one Planner spec, commit-first, then verifies committed bytes; uses scripts/verify.sh by EXIT CODE not stdout; never touches the frozen-three or composeEnding.

nodes.label: Auditor (agent)
nodes.rationale: Independent read-only verifier with NO Write/Edit. May BLOCK promotion even when the gate is green; a self-report is never evidence.

nodes.label: Planner -> Builder -> Gate -> Auditor loop
nodes.rationale: The 3-agent orchestration: per section planner -> builder -> scripts/verify.sh -> auditor -> promote | revert. The main session orchestrates.

nodes.label: Deterministic gate (scripts/verify.sh)
nodes.rationale: set -euo pipefail, exit-code-gated, refuses a vacuous pass: fewer than MIN_TESTS harnesses, a frozen-three function not found, or a missing baseline all FAIL. The gate is scripts, not an agent.

nodes.label: Zero-diff gate
nodes.rationale: The frozen-three must stay md5-identical to the committed baseline; composeEnding is golden-locked (NOT md5-frozen). Intentionally changing a frozen-three function = a deliberate act that updates the baseline in the same commit, never silent drift.

nodes.label: Frozen-three (applyOutcome/resolveCheck/tryCompose)
nodes.rationale: The three engine functions held md5-identical to test/frozen-baseline.json by scripts/frozen.js.

nodes.label: FAIL LOUD / no-silent-death
nodes.rationale: A check that passes without actually testing is worse than no check. Harnesses install a global error trap and assert a real terminal state; the build gate refuses a vacuous (false-green) pass.

nodes.label: The sacred list
nodes.rationale: Never change for any reason: permadeath, sampled-not-scripted outcomes, hidden meters (earth.truth / EARTH_DOOM_YEARS), the brutal economy, resource interdependence, emergent-tragedy bonds, and the Settler/Pioneer/Voyager tiers (the only legitimate difficulty lever).

nodes.label: Auditor input isolation
nodes.rationale: The Auditor gets ONLY {spec, commit SHA, gate results} — never the Builder's narration — and reads committed bytes itself (git show <SHA>) citing file:line. Tool-enforced: the Auditor has no Write/Edit.

nodes.label: Fenced items (need Tom's decision)
nodes.rationale: Never auto-build: the Planner returns FENCED. These touch save integrity, RNG stream, applier dedup, file ordering, or pacing — silent-risk changes that need a human decision.

nodes.label: S2-4 save integrity (fenced)
nodes.rationale: Save integrity. Fenced.

nodes.label: D2-1 void-leg pacing (fenced)
nodes.rationale: Void-leg pacing. Fenced.

nodes.label: S3-1 sibling-applier dedup (fenced)
nodes.rationale: Sibling-applier dedup would break the zero-diff gate. Fenced.

nodes.label: S2-2 seeded RNG (fenced)
nodes.rationale: Seeded RNG risks silent stream drift. Fenced.

nodes.label: S3-3 file split (fenced)
nodes.rationale: File split risks silent reorder. Fenced.

nodes.label: Plan-file discipline
nodes.rationale: The canonical plan is the COMMITTED docs/proxima-trail-implementation-plan.md, not the chat copy. Read fresh from HEAD, reconcile, append-only per milestone, re-fetch to verify the write landed.

nodes.label: CI gate (verify workflow)
nodes.rationale: GitHub Actions runs npm ci then bash scripts/verify.sh on push/PR with node 24. No '|| true', no continue-on-error — a red gate fails CI loudly, mount-independent.

nodes.label: No-silent-death harness contract
nodes.rationale: Every harness boots headless via the window.__PROXIMA_TEST__ seam, installs a global error trap (window.onerror + unhandledrejection / process handlers), drives a real scenario to a real terminal win/loss render, and exits nonzero on any failed assertion. A swallowed exception is a failed test, not a pass.

nodes.label: window.__PROXIMA_TEST__ test seam
nodes.rationale: Set before game.js loads, it attaches window.__proxima exposing newGame/composeEnding/beginColony/startVoyage/captureDigest/exodusYears etc. so harnesses drive the real engine.

nodes.label: AgenticOS remediation graph viewer
nodes.rationale: Self-contained vanilla SVG force-layout viewer of the agent pipeline + remediation web; the graphify pipeline owns the GRAPH-DATA block, rewritten from graph-state.json.

nodes.label: M-INT1 (endings re-tier)
nodes.rationale: Generalized composeEnding to weigh both fronts and re-tier endings; unfroze composeEnding from md5 to a golden lock verified by the endings_golden harness.

nodes.label: M-INT1b (parallel-fronts legibility layer)
nodes.rationale: Presentation-only wrapper over the live dual-front engine; makes the unfocused front legible without touching gameplay, rates, or odds. Engine stays byte-identical where the zero-diff gate applies. Built at ad92ece; Auditor PASS.

nodes.label: [2a] Both-fronts status strip
nodes.rationale: One slim .small dim line per HUD showing the off-front headline; reads existing state, computes nothing.

nodes.label: [3a] Single canonical shared clock
nodes.rationale: Repoint the colony 'Years since exodus' stat from col.elapsedYears to exodusYears() — one reconciled clock identical on both HUDs, no new line, no relabel. col.elapsedYears stays computed for colonyAgeDrift.

nodes.label: [1c] Adaptive off-front digest
nodes.rationale: captureDigest reads the off-tick's own log into a transient _offlog buffer (writes no front state), surfaced on toggle-back: a one-liner on a quiet beat, the captured entries verbatim on a major beat.

nodes.label: Dual-front engine (colony + ark)
nodes.rationale: A colony on Proxima runs in parallel with a crewed ark crossing home on a shared clock; acting on one front auto-ticks the other. tryCompose waits for both, composeEnding weighs both.

nodes.label: Exodus clock (exodusYears)
nodes.rationale: exodusYears() = round(shipYears + max(colony.year*CYCLE_YEARS, voyage.turn*VOY_YEARS_PER_TURN)); a generation-ship max() wall-clock, not relativistic dilation. The single reconciled Years-Since-Exodus value.

nodes.label: Endings matrix (composeEnding)
nodes.rationale: composeEnding folds colonyDone x voyageDone x beaconHeard into a tiered finale: the two-world matrix plus colony-only and voyage-only branches.

nodes.label: Ending: TWO WORLDS
nodes.rationale: Colony settled AND ship reaches home: humanity is no longer all in one place.

nodes.label: Ending: THE MESSENGER
nodes.rationale: Colony fell but the ship reached home with the maps, warnings, and survivors.

nodes.label: Ending: THE WORD GOT THROUGH
nodes.rationale: Both fronts lost, but the beacon reached a living Earth first: a partial win gated on beaconHeard.

nodes.label: Ending: EXTINCT
nodes.rationale: Colony withered and the ark swallowed by the dark, with no beacon: the long gamble lost.

nodes.label: Settler / Pioneer / Voyager tiers
nodes.rationale: The only legitimate difficulty lever (sacred). DIFFICULTY.harsh scales drains, hazards, hidden-meter thresholds, payoff odds, and decay rates.

nodes.label: beaconHeard (a beacon that reached a living Earth)
nodes.rationale: Set when the comms dish sends the beacon early while Earth is still live; the only message that beats silence. Turns a fallen run into THE WORD GOT THROUGH.
nodes.norm_label: beaconheard (a beacon that reached a living earth)

nodes.label: Hidden long-tail meters
nodes.rationale: Felt, never shown as a number; they surface as delayed events and ending beats. Each ships with at least one writer and one reader (no orphans).

nodes.label: Visible-effect + hidden-long-tail rule
nodes.rationale: Tom's standing rule: every action has (a) a visible immediate effect AND (b) at least one hidden long-tail consequence that compounds and re-surfaces as a delayed event and/or an ending beat. Consequences are mixed-horizon.

nodes.label: No-orphan-meter rule
nodes.rationale: No hidden meter ships without at least one writer AND one reader, and each has at least one named dramatic payoff so the long-tail is experienced, not silently tallied. The M-INT2 audit enforces this.

nodes.label: ecoHarm (hidden meter)
nodes.rationale: How badly you've scarred the biosphere. No passive recovery — only Restore/Rewild reduces it. Multiplies per-season survival drain (a scarred world is harder to live on).

nodes.label: nativeTrust (hidden meter)
nodes.rationale: The natives' deep, slow read of you; sets the ceiling/floor the visible relations meter gravitates toward, and gates the big forks (alliance / petition / the Reckoning). Must be raisable, not one-way doom.

nodes.label: contamination (hidden meter)
nodes.rationale: Accumulated biological/chemical hazard load from cutting corners; drives the sickness-wave severity. Passive recovery only while the front is safe and hope is high.

nodes.label: structuralDebt (hidden meter)
nodes.rationale: Corners cut in construction + materials robbed from the ship. Scales the return-ship refit cost/time UP (ties to shipReadiness) — strip now visibly taxes leave later. No passive recovery.

nodes.label: trauma (hidden meter)
nodes.rationale: The crew's psychological wear (slower and stickier than hope/morale). Lowers skill-check reliability; the homeward long dark hits harder. Tend heals it slowly.

nodes.label: hope (visible meter)
nodes.rationale: The colony's will; the one visible morale-class meter. 0 = abandonment (lose). Low hope cuts labor and raises breakdowns.

nodes.label: relations (visible surface stance)
nodes.rationale: The natives' surface stance right now: drives immediate trade and whether the next encounter reads friendly or tense. Fast-moving; reacts to your last few actions.

nodes.label: elapsedYears / Earth clock (visible)
nodes.rationale: Total Years-Since-Exodus across Phase 1 + colony + return; sets Earth-fate odds at home arrival (recovered -> changed -> silent -> gone). The dread engine.

nodes.label: Payoff: The Ground Remembers
nodes.rationale: Fires past ecoHarm ~60: a coordinated biosphere backlash; colors a Scorched ending beat.

nodes.label: Payoff: The Reckoning at the Treeline
nodes.rationale: Bidirectional, fires once late on nativeTrust: high trust -> they stand WITH you (allied); low trust -> against you (hostile).
nodes.norm_label: payoff: the reckoning at the treeline

nodes.label: Payoff: The Fever Season
nodes.rationale: Fires past contamination ~60: a colony-wide illness wave; colors a plague-scarred beat.

nodes.label: Payoff: The Long Crack
nodes.rationale: Fires past structuralDebt threshold: a major structure fails (habitat/power loss + casualties) and inflates the refit cost the moment you try to leave.

nodes.label: Payoff: The One Who Couldn't
nodes.rationale: Fires past trauma threshold: a named crewmate breaks permanently; colors a haunted-survivors beat.

nodes.label: Cascade: Labor/power hub
nodes.rationale: Finite labor + power; starving one survival or growth axis forces another to fail. The colony's analogue of Phase 1's power-is-the-hub — why the colony is a squeeze, not a checklist.

nodes.label: Cascade: The Earth clock
nodes.rationale: Total elapsedYears across every front sets home-fate odds; every turn spends it. The link that keeps Act II coupled to Phase 1.

nodes.label: Proxima Trail (the game)
nodes.rationale: An Oregon-Trail-lineage survival game: humanity's last ark crosses to Proxima Centauri b; permadeath, sampled outcomes, a brutal economy, and emergent-tragedy bonds.

nodes.label: index.html (playable game shell)
nodes.rationale: The CRT-framed single-page shell that loads audio.js + game.js and renders every screen into #app.
